title: Removing 1 Piece Until I BEAT Komodo
summary: Tony plays the Komodo engine, removing one of Komodo's pieces each game (starting with a rook, working 'down the board') until he wins. Game 1 (Komodo minus a rook) he loses; game 2 Komodo is missing a rook and a knight, and he wins by promoting a pawn.
rules: Game 1: Komodo starts without one rook.
After each loss remove one more Komodo piece (game 2: rook + a knight).

opponent.name: Komodo
opponent.avatar_description: green Komodo dragon/lizard cartoon with forked tongue

setup: Game 1: 1nbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQk - 0 1 (which rook is inferred a8). Game 2: 1nbqkb1r/... (rook + one knight removed; which knight unspecified).
